summary.en: SQL and data pipelines for LLM logs and eval datasets, Databricks essentials for GenAI (Unity Catalog, Delta, Vector Search, Model Serving, MLflow evaluation, Mosaic AI Agent Framework) aligned with the Generative AI Engineer Associate exam, plus when to fine-tune and when to self-host with vLLM.
summary.es: SQL y pipelines de datos para logs de LLM y datasets de evaluación, fundamentos de Databricks para GenAI (Unity Catalog, Delta, Vector Search, Model Serving, evaluación con MLflow, Mosaic AI Agent Framework) alineados con el examen Generative AI Engineer Associate, y cuándo hacer fine-tuning y cuándo autoalojar con vLLM.

description.en: Certification-style labs: SQL analysis of LLM logs and eval dataset builder, Vector Search index over Delta (with a local Chroma/pgvector fallback), and MLflow evaluation of a RAG chain.

description.en: Document intelligence pipeline for an insurance claims client: PDFs to Volumes, parsed chunks in Delta, Vector Search, extraction + Q&A chain, MLflow evaluation and a served endpoint.
description.es: Pipeline de inteligencia documental para un cliente de reclamos de seguros: PDFs en Volumes, chunks parseados en Delta, Vector Search, cadena de extracción + Q&A, evaluación con MLflow y un endpoint servido.
